始.english: Teacher Wang, what time does the exam start?

始.sentence: 八点半开始。大家别迟到。
始.pinyin: Bā diǎn bàn kāishǐ. dàjiā bié chídào.
始.english: It starts at eight thirty. Everyone, don't be late.

每.sentence: 我们班每一个同学都能通过吗？
每.pinyin: Wǒmen bān měi yī gè tóngxué dōu néng tōngguò ma?
每.english: Can every student in our class pass?

别.sentence: 八点半开始。大家别迟到。
别.pinyin: Bā diǎn bàn kāishǐ. dàjiā bié chídào.
别.english: It starts at eight thirty. Everyone, don't be late.

因.sentence: 我进步比较慢，因为我以前没学过。
因.pinyin: Wǒ jìnbù bǐjiào màn, yīnwèi wǒ yǐqián méi xué guo.
因.english: I make progress rather slowly, because I didn't study it before.
